function Reset-Waivers($s) {

}

health.ps1 行号问题类型描述修复代码158protocolstale request 按设计应是 WARN，当前 ok=($stale.Count -eq 0) 会把 stale 直接计为 FAIL，拉低 health 等级。powershell

179-188missing-guardPlaywright 只检查 chromium.executablePath() 是否存在，没有实际 launch。之前目标是验证“浏览器真能启动”，路径存在不等于可用。powershell
# 替换 Playwright Chromium binary 检查里的 node -e
$nodeCode = @'
const { chromium } = require("playwright");
(async () => {
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
await browser.close();
console.log("chromium_launch_ok");
})().catch(err => {
console.error(err && err.stack ? err.stack : String(err));
process.exit(1);
});
'@

try {
Push-Location $pipelineDir
$chromiumOut = & node -e $nodeCode 2>&1
$chromiumOk = ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) -and (($chromiumOut -join "`n") -match "chromium_launch_ok")
Pop-Location
$checks.Add((Check "playwright_chromium" $chromiumOk $(if($chromiumOk){'launch ok'}else{($chromiumOut -join ' ')})))
} catch {
try { Pop-Location -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
$checks.Add((Check "playwright_chromium" $false $_.Exception.Message))
}
